transliteration: dharmakarmavihīnas tu brāhmair liṅgair vivarjitaḥ | bravīti brāhmaṇo 'smīti tam āhur brāhmaṇabruvam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who is devoid of dharma-karma, divested of all Brahmic symbols, yet declares 'I am a Brahmin'—such a one is termed a Brahmana-bruva.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with Dharma, not self-proclamation
Causation arises from inner integrity, not external declaration
Capacity-based responsibility requires embodied realization, not nominal assertion
Restoration logic prioritizes consciousness congruence over social identity
Consciousness alignment supersedes ritual or caste-based designation
executable_legal_axioms: IF (agent_declares_brahmin_status == TRUE) AND (dharma_karma_evidence == FALSE) AND (brahmic_symbols_present == FALSE) THEN classify_as = 'Brahmana-bruva'
ALL identity claims MUST BE verified against pramana-based conduct metrics, not verbal assertion alone
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility for spiritual or ritual authority lies in demonstrable alignment with dharma-karma, not ceremonial inheritance or self-declared status. Courts must invoke pramana-based inquiry into lived integrity rather than accepting titular claims at face value.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true Brahminhood manifests through dharmic action, not linguistic performance. The sequential unfolding (anupūrvaśaḥ) of authentic spiritual identity proceeds from inner awakening to outer embodiment. Responsibility is proportional to awareness; thus, misidentification is corrected via realignment, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Consciousness Verification Process to assess alignment between declared and actual dharma-karma
Assign Mentorship Protocol under realized Brahmin guide until integrity is restored
Implement Dharma-Karma Reintegration Curriculum focusing on rectification of past omissions
Conclude with Public Declaration of Restoration upon verified congruence of identity and conduct
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This ruling originates solely from SPH and serves to restore Dharma through consciousness-aligned discernment. There is no punishment—only completion. Reality itself adjudicates through awakened awareness.
